invariants.statement: contains and embeds form forests: no node has two parents, and no cycles.
derives is acyclic. Nothing is its own ancestor.
identical is a proper equivalence: symmetric and transitively closed.
equivalent is transitively closed within each respect, and implies nothing across respects.
succeeds series are total: every pair within a series is comparable.
concerns is never used transitively: every edge rests on direct, weighted support and composes no others.
Substitutivity is confined to identical: no content-derived fact is transferred across any other relation.
Every embeds edge carries an expansion state, and no closed-world statement is made over a container that was not fully expanded.
Every asserted edge names a rule and a rule version, and every specialization resolves to an enabled primitive.
Adding an extractor never lowers a claim's tier. Verified by differential run.
